effect.teeming.heavy.description: You are weighed down: no jumping, you fall faster, and Levitation and Slow Falling don't work.
effect.teeming.nulled.description: You stand in a Nullcantor's ring: the enchantments on your gear do nothing. Curses still hold.
effect.teeming.silenced.description: You can't use items: no eating, drinking, bows, shields or throwing.
effect.teeming.sunder.description: Your armor is cracked: each stack takes away 4 armor points until it wears off.
effect.teeming.swallowed.description: Something is holding you: swallowed, coiled or gripped.
effect.teeming.void_rot.description: Your body won't mend: no natural regeneration, and all healing is halved.
guide.teeming.ash_jackal.counter: Kill the one carrying your item before it gets away: it drops what it took. It never wanders off for good while it carries something. Better still, don't drop loot in front of a pack.
guide.teeming.ash_jackal.home: The Nether wastes and the soul sand valleys, in packs of two or three.
guide.teeming.ash_jackal.role: A lean, big-eared scavenger dog of the wastes. Each one snatches a dropped item stack within ten blocks, carries it in its jaws and runs off with it for ten seconds. In a fight the pack goes for whoever is most hurt, player or mob.
guide.teeming.ash_jackal.tell: It stops dead and sniffs, nose up and ears pricked, for half a second before it snatches an item or bites. Step back or strike then. Watch for the item in its jaws and keep your health up, because the pack singles out the weakest.
guide.teeming.ashharrier.counter: Raise a shield into the stoop: it crashes into it and lies stunned on the ground for two seconds. If it has you, hit it at once. Any blow while it carries you makes it let go, and the sooner you hit it, the shorter your fall.
guide.teeming.ashharrier.home: The basalt deltas, circling over the ash falls.
guide.teeming.ashharrier.role: A broad-winged bird of prey. It stoops on you, grabs you in its talons, climbs six to nine blocks with you and lets go. The fall is what hurts.
guide.teeming.ashharrier.tell: It stops in the air with a piercing cry, folds its wings back and sheds ash. The stoop follows.
guide.teeming.astral_augur.counter: Step out of the circles; stepping toward it always gets you clear. Or hit it while it channels: the circles fade, and one of its motes cracks off and falls as a star mote. Every mote it loses is one circle fewer.
guide.teeming.astral_augur.home: The End's main island once the dragon is dead, and the End highlands. Alone.
guide.teeming.astral_augur.role: A tall, robed star-reader with a halo of orbiting star motes that keeps its distance. Every five seconds it reads the stars over whatever it hunts within sixteen blocks: circles of starlight open on the ground under and behind its prey, then strike down hard.
guide.teeming.astral_augur.tell: It raises both hands high and its motes spin faster with a rising chime, while three rings of star-white light fill in on the ground: one under you and two behind you.
guide.teeming.aurovore.counter: Kill it before it gets away: it drops everything it ever stole. Better still, keep gold out of your pack when one is about. It never takes the armour you wear or what you hold in either hand.
guide.teeming.aurovore.home: Bastion remnants and the Nether wastes, alone.
guide.teeming.aurovore.role: A small, greedy lizard with a gold crest that sniffs out gold. Each bite that lands takes one gold item from your pack, and then it runs off with it for ten seconds. It keeps everything it takes: the newest piece in its jaws, more on its back.
guide.teeming.aurovore.tell: Before every bite it stops dead, stretches its neck toward you and sniffs for half a second, nose twitching and crest raised, while the gold it has picked out glints on you.
guide.teeming.basalt_behemoth.counter: Get out of the ring of dust while it rears, or jump as it lands: only what is on the ground is hit. After every slam its chest plates slide apart for three seconds. The gold core has no armour and takes double damage, but it keeps walking and swatting while open.
guide.teeming.basalt_behemoth.home: Basalt deltas. Rare: only one roams any stretch of the deltas.
guide.teeming.basalt_behemoth.role: The Nether's first apex: a walking mound of basalt columns with a molten core sealed in its chest. Slow and heavy, and it hits like a falling pillar.
guide.teeming.basalt_behemoth.tell: It rears up on its hind legs, roaring, with embers and dust pouring from its joints, then slams both forelimbs down: everything on the ground within four blocks is hit hard and thrown back.
guide.teeming.blackstone_scuttler.counte: Bring a pickaxe: every blow cracks its shell for triple damage, with a crack and a spray of chips. When it rears, step aside: the lunge goes only where it was aimed.
guide.teeming.blackstone_scuttler.home: Basalt deltas, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.blackstone_scuttler.role: A low, heavy scuttler whose shell is fused blackstone. Swords, axes, maces, tridents, bare fists and every arrow glance off it for less than a third of their damage, but a pickaxe cracks the stone for triple.
guide.teeming.blackstone_scuttler.tell: It rears up on its back legs and lifts both claws, grinding and shedding blackstone dust, for just over half a second. Then it lunges straight ahead and pinches.
guide.teeming.brinkram.counter: Keep solid ground at your back when it paws. Or stand at an edge and step aside: a charge that runs out of ground goes over most of the time, and its drop is left at the brink. If it skids to a stop and teeters with its rump glowing gold, one hit tips it over.
guide.teeming.brinkram.home: End midlands, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.brinkram.role: A heavy ram with curled purpur horns. It charges in a straight line and throws whatever it hits far back, over the edge of an island if one is behind you.
guide.teeming.brinkram.tell: It paws the ground, snorts and lowers its horns for a second while dust kicks up.
guide.teeming.chorus_grazer.counter: Walk up to it, don't sprint, and shear it for one or two purpur fleece. Only chorus fruit grows the fleece back: drop one near a shorn grazer and it walks over to eat it. A startled herd shies from you for five seconds and can't be sheared until it settles.
guide.teeming.chorus_grazer.home: End highlands, in herds of two to four, wandering among the chorus.
guide.teeming.chorus_grazer.role: A placid, woolly grazer with chorus growing from its back. It never attacks. Startle one and the whole herd blinks a few blocks away and stays wary for a while. Feed two of them chorus fruit and they bring a calf.
guide.teeming.chorus_grazer.tell: It has no warning to watch for: it never fights. A hurt grazer, or a player sprinting close by, sends the herd blinking away with a soft pop.
guide.teeming.chorus_husk.counter: Back out of the four-block burst while it swells. A burst that catches no player leaves two whole chorus fruit behind. Among other mobs, let the burst scatter them instead.
guide.teeming.chorus_husk.home: End highlands, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.chorus_husk.role: A shambling husk overgrown with chorus, fat violet pods bursting from its back and shoulders. It fights with its claws, and when it dies it doesn't fall: its pods swell for a second and burst, flinging everything within four blocks away as if they had eaten chorus fruit.
guide.teeming.chorus_husk.tell: Before a blow it rears both arms back over its head. When it dies its pods bulge and glow lilac and a crackle rises for a second before the burst.
guide.teeming.cindermoth_swarm.counter: Put your light away and it loses interest. Or drop a torch: it hovers on it for ten seconds, burning no one, while you slip past. A hit scatters the cloud for two seconds, and a full sword sweep cuts it apart. Fire resistance shrugs off its burn.
guide.teeming.cindermoth_swarm.home: Soul sand valleys and the nether wastes, drifting alone.
guide.teeming.cindermoth_swarm.role: A cloud of small glowing moths, drawn to light. It drifts slowly toward the brightest light within twelve blocks: one you hold, or a light lying on the ground. Whatever it touches burns, a point of damage every second.
guide.teeming.cindermoth_swarm.tell: When it reaches you it stops and flares for just over half a second: the moths pull into a tight, bright knot with a rising flutter and a spray of sparks. Step out of the cloud before it engulfs you.
guide.teeming.dripfang.counter: When you hear or see the drip, step aside: it drops on the spot where you stood. A miss sticks its point in the ground for three seconds: its crown glows gold and it takes half again as much damage. Then it hauls itself back up.
guide.teeming.dripfang.home: Dripstone caves. It hangs from the ceiling among the real dripstone, one more stone fang.
guide.teeming.dripfang.role: A living stalactite. It waits on the ceiling for something to walk beneath it, then drops point-first.
guide.teeming.dripfang.tell: Water drips from its tip with a soft drip, and it shivers for just over half a second before it lets go.
guide.teeming.dunefin.counter: Stand on anything that isn't sand and it can't reach you. Step off the sand onto stone as its fin rises: it leaps after you, lands on the hard ground and lies stunned for three seconds.
guide.teeming.dunefin.home: Deserts, swimming under the sand in any light.
guide.teeming.dunefin.role: A sand shark. It swims through the sand with only its fin showing and hunts anyone standing on sand.
guide.teeming.dunefin.tell: Its fin rises out of the sand right under you for three quarters of a second. Then it breaches and bites.
guide.teeming.dustwhirl.counter: Sneak through the gust: it pushes you half as hard, and sneaking keeps you from being blown off a ledge. When it slows down afterwards its core shows; hit it then for half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.dustwhirl.home: Savannas and wooded badlands, by day or night.
guide.teeming.dustwhirl.role: A small dust devil with a glowing core. It drags any dropped item within eight blocks into itself and keeps it until it dies.
guide.teeming.dustwhirl.tell: It spins up for a second, dust rising round it and a whistle climbing, then blasts everyone near it outward for three seconds.
guide.teeming.facet_doppel.counter: Meet it holding something weak, or switch to something weak while it flickers, then switch to your best weapon. A blow from a weapon that outclasses its copy shatters its facets: the armour it copied is gone for good.
guide.teeming.facet_doppel.role: A broad figure of faceted mirror-glass. The first player it sees, it copies: their armour, and the attack damage of whatever they hold, with a glass copy of it in its hand. A bare hand copies as a fist. Enchantments and effects don't carry over, and the copy never changes after.
guide.teeming.facet_doppel.tell: When it first sees you it stands still and flickers for a second, its facets shimmering, then rings like struck glass: that is the moment it copies you. Before each blow it raises its glass copy overhead.
guide.teeming.flamewright.counter: Hit it while it draws the sigil: it staggers for two seconds and the pattern is lost. Too late? Look for the gaps: step between the fireballs of a ring, around the arms of a cross, or round with the spiral. A shield blocks them.
guide.teeming.flamewright.role: A robed pyromancer that fills fortress halls with fireballs. It casts three patterns in turn: a spiral, a ring and a cross. Each fireball flies slowly and straight, and stops at the first wall.
guide.teeming.flamewright.tell: It stops, raises its hands and draws a burning sigil in the air for a second, roaring, as flames circle it. The sigil glows gold.
guide.teeming.fortress_jailer.counter: Get out of its sight while the chain whirls, or raise a shield toward it: the chain drops and nothing is pulled. The chain flies straight, so a step aside also makes it miss. Hooked, you are dragged to it and struck.
guide.teeming.fortress_jailer.role: A tall, armoured warden of the fortress halls. It throws a heavy chain at intruders up to twelve blocks away and drags whoever it hooks to its side.
guide.teeming.fortress_jailer.tell: It raises its fist and whirls the chain over its head for most of a second, rattling, then throws it straight at you.
guide.teeming.gatecaster.counter: When you hear the whine, turn round: step aside once the gate stops turning, or raise a shield toward it. A blocked bolt goes back through the gate and drags the caster out after it, right in front of you, where its own bolt bursts at its feet.
guide.teeming.gatecaster.role: A hunched, robed rift-weaver holding a ring of violet light between its hands. It keeps its distance, and every four seconds it opens a gate behind whatever it hunts within sixteen blocks and fires a bolt out of it into its prey's back.
guide.teeming.gatecaster.tell: Its hands glow and its ring spins up, and with a rising whine a violet ring of light opens in the air three to five blocks behind you, at chest height. The gate turns to follow you for a moment, then holds still just before the bolt.
guide.teeming.gleamtrap.counter: Watch the shroomlights for the pulse and kill a Gleamtrap from range: its bite reaches only a block. If one splits open beside you, step back.
guide.teeming.gleamtrap.home: Crimson and warped forests, sitting on the caps of huge fungi among the real shroomlights.
guide.teeming.gleamtrap.role: An ambush mob that passes for a shroomlight. It never moves. It bites whatever touches it, hits it or stands next to it for two seconds.
guide.teeming.gleamtrap.tell: Every four seconds it pulses: its glow swells and fades and its top lifts a crack. Before it bites it splits open for half a second and shows its teeth.
guide.teeming.glimmerless.counter: Watch the ground for its footprints and hit it with anything you can throw or shoot: a snowball, an egg, an arrow, a trident or a wind charge. For ten seconds it is seen and glows faintly, and it flinches back from the hit, which breaks off a strike. Then fight it in the open.
guide.teeming.glimmerless.home: The End highlands and midlands, alone.
guide.teeming.glimmerless.role: An invisible stalker. You never see it coming: only pale violet footprints that fade behind it and a soft crunch with every step.
guide.teeming.glimmerless.tell: Before it strikes, a shimmer rises where it stands, its outline shows for a moment and it hisses.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.counter: Kill the alpha: the big one with horns, a collar of bone spikes and glowing marks down its sides. When it dies the rest of the pack runs for ten seconds. Step aside from a dart when you see the crouch.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.home: Taiga forests at night, in packs of three or four.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.role: A starved, hunch-backed hound of the gloom with a ridge of bone down its back and eyes that glow in the dark. The pack circles you and takes turns: only one darts in at a time, while the horned alpha howls to speed the others up.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.tell: The hound whose turn it is drops low, raises its spines and growls for a moment, then darts in to bite.
guide.teeming.gloomweaver.counter: Carry an axe or fire. One axe swing, a flint and steel, a fire charge or lava on any part of a wall brings the whole wall down at once, and snaps its threads: for five seconds it can't spin another. Other blows only scratch the wall. Up close it bites.
guide.teeming.gloomweaver.role: A broad weaver that spins walls of warped vine across your path, five wide and three tall. They block your way and your sight for ten seconds, then wither away.
guide.teeming.gloomweaver.tell: It rears up and its spinnerets whirl, glowing and rustling, with vines twisting round them. A second later the wall goes up between you.
guide.teeming.hollow_mourner.counter: Hit it. A hit staggers it for two seconds and breaks the chant, and nothing rises. It shrugs off blows for a moment after, but a chant always breaks. Better still, kill it before you clear the dead round it.
guide.teeming.hollow_mourner.home: Anywhere on land in the Overworld at night, but never the mushroom fields. In swamps it wears moss and mud.
guide.teeming.hollow_mourner.role: A mourner that brings the dead back. It remembers every undead mob that falls within eight blocks of it for thirty seconds, and every ten seconds it raises one where it fell, so the fight you just won starts again. The raised dead carry nothing worth taking.
guide.teeming.hollow_mourner.tell: It stops, raises both arms high and chants for three seconds while souls rise from the grave.
guide.teeming.hollowmind.counter: Hit the parasite itself: on the enderman's head it glows gold. Kill it there and the enderman calms down and leaves you be. Kill the enderman instead and the parasite drops off and scurries for another one within sixteen blocks; you have five seconds to finish it.
guide.teeming.hollowmind.role: A small void parasite, a cleft dome with a lilac core and trailing tendrils. It creeps toward any enderman near by, climbs onto its head and rides it: the enderman turns on you, moves faster, hits half again as hard and no longer fears water or rain.
guide.teeming.hollowmind.tell: Before it climbs on it crouches flat beside the enderman, all six tendrils reach straight up and its core swells with a wet pulse, for a full second. Up close it rears and opens its little maw before it nips.
guide.teeming.hushwing.counter: Walk or sneak: it never hears quiet steps. Throw a snowball, egg or arrow away from you and the whole flock chases the impact for five seconds.
guide.teeming.hushwing.home: Deep caves below y 0, in flocks of three or four.
guide.teeming.hushwing.role: A blind cave bat. It cannot see you: it hears a sprint within sixteen blocks, a fight within twelve and mining within ten, flies to the noise and bites.
guide.teeming.hushwing.tell: No warning before a bite. When it hears something, its big ears snap up and flick and a ring of sound rises over it.
guide.teeming.keening_shade.counter: Break its line of sight while it breathes in: step behind a block or a tree. A wail that silences no one tears its voice: it sinks to the ground, voiceless, and can't wail again for twenty seconds.
guide.teeming.keening_shade.role: A hunched, legless spectre in a trailing shroud that drifts above the sand and keens. Every ten seconds, with you within ten blocks, it wails: everyone within ten blocks who can see it is Silenced for four seconds and can't use any item: no eating, no potions, no shield, no bow.
guide.teeming.keening_shade.tell: Its chest caves in and its head tips back for most of a second as it draws a long, rising breath, pulling soul wisps into its mouth.
guide.teeming.lavaleaper.counter: Stay more than four blocks from the lava. Better: hook it with a fishing rod as it surfaces and reel it in. It lands on the shore, helpless for five seconds, and takes half again as much from every blow.
guide.teeming.lavaleaper.home: Lava seas in every Nether biome, swimming under the surface.
guide.teeming.lavaleaper.role: A lean fish that lurks under the lava and ambushes anything standing near the shore. Its bite sets you alight.
guide.teeming.lavaleaper.tell: Bubbles and a glow rise to the lava's surface for half a second, right where it lurks. Then it leaps out at you, bites and flops back in.
guide.teeming.levimoth.counter: Keep out of the cloud, above all near an island's edge. Slow Falling makes the drop afterwards harmless.
guide.teeming.levimoth.role: A dusky moth with a weak bite. Threaten it and it shakes out a cloud of dust that lifts whatever is inside.
guide.teeming.levimoth.tell: It flares its wings wide and its dust sacs pulse for a moment.
guide.teeming.liftstone_monolith.counter: Get a roof over your head: any solid block within three blocks above you stops the pull, and you stay on the ground. A pull that catches on a roof jars its capstone, which splits after the slam and shows the gold heart inside: for four seconds it has no armour.
guide.teeming.liftstone_monolith.home: The End's main island, once the dragon is dead. Rare: only one stands in any stretch of it.
guide.teeming.liftstone_monolith.role: The End's apex: a towering slab of end stone with a capstone floating over it. It drifts slowly across the island and pulls everything round it into the air.
guide.teeming.liftstone_monolith.tell: Its capstone rises and the runes down its face light one by one from the bottom, with a deep rising hum. When the last rune lights, everything within six blocks is lifted six blocks into the air, held, and slammed down hard.
guide.teeming.magma_tortoise.counter: Feed it magma cream and it follows you for thirty seconds, paddling after you across the lava. Stand on its shell and it swims the way you look, carrying you over the lava sea.
guide.teeming.magma_tortoise.home: Lava seas in every Nether biome, floating at the surface.
guide.teeming.magma_tortoise.role: A huge, slow tortoise that paddles across the lava. It never attacks, nothing burns it, and the top of its shell is solid enough to stand on.
guide.teeming.magma_tortoise.tell: It has no warning to watch for: it never fights back.
guide.teeming.mending_crystalling.counte: Kill it first. Any hit at all breaks it, even a snowball or the weakest arrow. It shatters, the creature it was mending stops glowing and healing, and it leaves a void crystal behind.
guide.teeming.mending_crystalling.home: The End's main island, once the dragon is dead.
guide.teeming.mending_crystalling.role: A small floating crystal that never attacks. It hangs back behind the fight and ties a beam of violet light to the most hurt End creature within twelve blocks, healing it two health a second. The creature it mends glows. It keeps that creature between itself and you.
guide.teeming.mending_crystalling.tell: None: its beam locks on with a soft chime the moment something near it is hurt. Follow the line of light back to the crystal.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.counter: Step off the bubbles before they stop. If it swallows you, hit it three times, from inside or from outside: it spits you out and is stunned for two seconds, taking half again as much damage. Otherwise it chews on you for five seconds before it lets go.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.home: Swamps and mangrove swamps, lying hidden under shallow water.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.role: A wide-mouthed ambusher. Under the water nothing can see it, mobs can't target it and arrows go straight past it. A few bubbles are the only sign that it is there.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.tell: Bubbles boil up from the water right under you for a second. Then it lunges up and swallows whatever is standing over it.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.counter: Fire. A shambler that is burning, or dies to fire, crumbles to ash with no burst and no spores. Otherwise step back from a falling one: the spores reach two blocks.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.home: Dark forests and caves, but never on the mushroom fields.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.role: A slow fungal shambler. When it dies it bursts into two smaller ones, and those burst again, each burst a puff of poison spores.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.tell: It swings without warning. As it falls, its cap and spore sacs swell for a moment before it bursts.
guide.teeming.nullcantor.counter: Fight it from outside the ring with a bow or a trident, or walk in with plain gear and step back from its swing. A hit from outside the ring knocks its collar off: the ring stays where the collar fell for eight seconds, so lead it away and fight it with your enchantments working.
guide.teeming.nullcantor.home: The End's main island once the dragon is dead, and the End barrens. Alone.
guide.teeming.nullcantor.role: A tall, hooded chanter with a hollow face and a wide choir collar. It never stops singing: within eight blocks of it, marked by a violet ring on the ground and a low hum, the enchantments on your gear do nothing at all. Curses still hold.
guide.teeming.nullcantor.tell: Up close it raises both arms and its chant swells for half a second, then it brings its arms down on you.
guide.teeming.ossuary_wyrm.counter: Step out of its line while the flames rise, and the skull bites the ground. Its skull glows gold while it is out of the sand: hit it there for double, as blows on the vertebrae do only half. It can't swim through anything but soul sand and soul soil, so it won't follow you off the valley floor.
guide.teeming.ossuary_wyrm.home: Soul sand valleys, swimming through the soul sand and soul soil.
guide.teeming.ossuary_wyrm.role: A long serpent of fused bone that swims through soul sand as if it were water. Under the surface you see only a trail of soul sparks and hear the ground rumble.
guide.teeming.ossuary_wyrm.tell: The ground rumbles and soul flames rise from the sand about six blocks from you for a second, the tips of its horns breaking the surface. Then its skull leaps out in a great arc and comes down on you, its body following through the same arc.
guide.teeming.pearlgulp.counter: Don't throw pearls near it. If it has eaten yours, stand and fight: it only blinks to reach a target far off or to flee once badly hurt, and each blink burns one of your pearls. Kill it and it spills the pearls it still holds.
guide.teeming.pearlgulp.home: End highlands and the small End islands, alone.
guide.teeming.pearlgulp.role: A squat, wide-mouthed void creature with a glowing pouch under its jaw. It watches the air for ender pearls: one thrown within eight blocks of it is snapped up and swallowed, and its thrower stays where they stood. Each pearl it holds lets it blink eight blocks once, to close on its target or to get away when badly hurt. Its pouch glows a little brighter for each pearl inside.
guide.teeming.pearlgulp.tell: Before a blink toward you its throat flares: it rears up, its mouth opens and the pouch blazes lilac-white. Before it bites, its jaw drops wide.
guide.teeming.petalkin.counter: Find the real one: the copies cast no shadow and make no sound, not even footsteps. A hit pops a copy into petals and does nothing else.
guide.teeming.petalkin.home: Cherry groves, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.petalkin.role: A shy cherry-blossom sprite that leaves you alone. Hit it and it blinks up to six blocks away in a puff of petals, leaving three copies of itself where it stood, then comes back to peck at you.
guide.teeming.petalkin.tell: No warning before it pecks. The copies last five seconds and look just like it.
guide.teeming.phantasm_lantern.counter: Look at the ground: illusions cast no shadow. Don't waste swings on them. Find the lantern and kill it, and every illusion vanishes at once. Each blow on it gutters its flame and snuffs its newest illusion.
guide.teeming.phantasm_lantern.home: Warped forests; in crimson forests it glows red.
guide.teeming.phantasm_lantern.role: A hooded lantern-spirit that drifts at head height and keeps its distance. It never strikes you itself. Every ten seconds it conjures up to three illusions of the creatures around it. They look real and rush you, but they have one health point, do no harm and pop at a touch.
guide.teeming.phantasm_lantern.tell: It stops in the air, its cowl tips back and the flame in its cage swells and spins, with a whispering chime and pale blue wisps swirling in.
guide.teeming.prismback.counter: Fight it up close between flashes and hold your blows while it shines. A flash with nothing to turn burns its light out: for two seconds its prisms go dark and arrows strike home. Its belly is bare, so a shot rising into it from below gets through.
guide.teeming.prismback.role: A low, armoured lizard with a ridge of quartz prisms down its back. Arrows, tridents, snowballs and fire charges that strike it are turned round and sent straight back the way they came.
guide.teeming.prismback.tell: Every six seconds its prisms glimmer with a chime and a shower of sparks, then blaze white-hot for a second. While they blaze, half of every blow you land on it comes back at you.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.counter: Kill it first, from range if it runs. Hit it while its cap swells and the cap bursts early: no spores for the pack, and it reels for two seconds.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.home: Dark forests, among the big mushrooms.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.role: A little mushroom shepherd that keeps to the back of a fight. Every eight seconds it puffs spores that heal and hasten the monsters round it, and it runs from you if you come within six blocks.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.tell: Its cap swells up and sheds spores for a moment before the puff.
guide.teeming.pyre_herald.counter: Reach it and kill it first: alone it is weak. Hit it while the brazier is raised and it drops it: nobody gets a shell, and it has to pick the brazier up before it can rally again.
guide.teeming.pyre_herald.role: A small, hunched herald that carries a brazier for the fortress. Every ten seconds in a fight it raises the brazier and wraps every blaze, wither skeleton and Nether creature within ten blocks in a shell of embers that soaks up four hearts. It keeps its allies between itself and you.
guide.teeming.pyre_herald.tell: It raises its brazier high over its head for a second, its wings spread, with a horn-like call and embers rising.
guide.teeming.quakehopper.counter: Watch the ring of dust racing out from where it lands, and jump as it reaches you: in the air it can't touch you. Clear it, and the hopper's legs give out: for five seconds it can't hop and only lumbers after you.
guide.teeming.quakehopper.role: A heavy basalt hopper. It leaps high and lands with a quake that ripples out along the ground and knocks everything standing there flying.
guide.teeming.quakehopper.tell: It crouches low for most of a second, its hind legs glowing and creaking, smoke rising off them. Then it hops high towards you.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.counter: Back off. Once you are more than eight blocks away it calms down. Step within four blocks after the rattle and it strikes, and the bite poisons you.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.home: Badlands, out in the open in any light. A paler Sidewinder turns up in deserts now and then.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.role: A rattlesnake that wants to be left alone. It never hunts you, but it won't let you walk past it either.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.tell: Come within six blocks and it coils, lifts its head and shakes its raised rattle for a second and a half.
guide.teeming.riftjackal.counter: Turn to face the shimmer before it lands. Caught in your sight, the jackal is thrown eight blocks away through its own rift, which snaps shut: no bite and no rift left behind. Keep track of the rifts and step around them.
guide.teeming.riftjackal.home: End highlands, in packs of two or three.
guide.teeming.riftjackal.role: A lean, long-legged jackal of void-black hide with violet rift light down its spine. The pack circles you and blinks in one at a time: each jackal tears through to your side or back and bites as it lands, and leaves a flat violet rift on the ground where it vanished. For three seconds the rift throws anyone who steps in eight blocks away, always onto safe ground.
guide.teeming.riftjackal.tell: It crouches low, its spine light flares and it hums, and a violet shimmer gathers on the ground beside or behind you where it will land.
guide.teeming.scarlet_mantis.counter: Hold your blows while its blades glow red and strike when it lowers them. Arrows and other shots still land while it stands guard, so a bow wins the stance for you.
guide.teeming.scarlet_mantis.home: Crimson forests, alone. One that strays into the Nether wastes is grey with ash.
guide.teeming.scarlet_mantis.role: A tall crimson mantis with two great scythe arms. It slashes hard up close, and every few seconds it takes a parry stance that turns every blow aside.
guide.teeming.scarlet_mantis.tell: It stops, raises its scythes crossed before its face with a whetting rasp and a shower of red sparks, and holds them there, its blades glowing red. While they glow, a blow you land does nothing: the scythes catch it and you stagger, slowed and unable to strike for a second and a half.
guide.teeming.shardling_colossus.counter: A hit of eight or more, or wearing it below half health, splits it in two. Kill one half within five seconds: if both still live then, they walk together and rejoin with their health added up, and a rejoined colossus never splits again. Each half drops its own void crystal.
guide.teeming.shardling_colossus.role: A heavy golem of violet void crystal with a glowing seam down its middle. Hit hard, it splits along the seam into two smaller halves that fight on.
guide.teeming.shardling_colossus.tell: Before it slams, its seam cracks and glows and it raises both arms with a grinding note, while lilac dust marks how far the slam reaches in front of it. Step back or to the side.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.counter: Hit it with a shovel, or knock it back hard (a sprinting hit will do), to flip it onto its back. For three seconds it can't fight back and its belly takes double damage.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.home: Beaches and stony shores, in small groups.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.role: A crab that leaves you alone until you strike it. Its shell and claws turn every blow from the front, and then it pinches back.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.tell: It raises both claws and opens them for a moment before it pinches.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.counter: Get near heat: fire, a lit campfire or lava within three blocks of you snaps the beam. Or break its line of sight. Leather armour keeps the cold out, but it still heals.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.home: Snowy plains, ice spikes and frozen peaks, at night.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.role: A frost spirit that drains warmth through a beam. While the beam holds you freeze, and it heals.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.tell: It raises its arms toward you and a thin frost beam flickers between you for a moment before it locks on.
guide.teeming.shredjaw_beetle.counter: Raise a shield toward it as the jaws open: the bite does nothing, the beetle reels back and its own shell cracks. Or step back out of reach before the jaws close, and keep away while the cracks in your armour fade.
guide.teeming.shredjaw_beetle.home: Crimson and warped forests, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.shredjaw_beetle.role: A heavy beetle whose saw-toothed jaws crush armour. Each bite cracks your armour for ten seconds, up to three times over, and grinds every piece you wear.
guide.teeming.shredjaw_beetle.tell: It stops and throws its jaws wide open, grinding and clicking, sparks flying off the blades, for just over half a second before they slam shut.
guide.teeming.siphonjelly.counter: Step back when it flares. Kill it while it glows and you get the effect back with the time it had left. Fight it without buffs: a sting that finds nothing to take starves it, and it sinks and can't sting for five seconds.
guide.teeming.siphonjelly.home: The air of warped and crimson forests.
guide.teeming.siphonjelly.role: A see-through jelly that drifts after you. Its sting takes the longest-lasting good effect you have, up to thirty seconds of it, and it glows in that effect's colour and uses it while it holds it.
guide.teeming.siphonjelly.tell: Its bell flares open and its tendrils light up with a wet chime, half a second before the sting.
guide.teeming.skreel.counter: Raise a shield into the dive. A blocked Skreel crashes and lies stunned for three seconds, taking half again as much damage. Or step out of the line.
guide.teeming.skreel.home: Windswept hills and stony and jagged peaks, by day or night.
guide.teeming.skreel.role: A mountain raptor that circles ten to twenty blocks above its prey and drops on it from the sky.
guide.teeming.skreel.tell: It stops in the air, tips nose-down and screeches for a second, and a line of wind points at you.
guide.teeming.slagheart_golem.counter: Cool it: a snowball takes off a little heat, splash water more, powder snow all of it. Cooled right down it is quenched for three seconds and takes half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.slagheart_golem.role: A slag golem that heats up as it fights. Its cracks glow brighter at each stage of heat.
guide.teeming.slagheart_golem.tell: At full heat it raises its arms and shakes for a second, then erupts: fire and heavy damage within five blocks.
guide.teeming.slagspitter.counter: Step aside while the ring glows, or raise a shield toward it, and step out of the burning patches. Better, rush it: come within five blocks and it chokes on its shot and hops away. Keep it hopping and it never gets a shot off; up close it only nips.
guide.teeming.slagspitter.home: Nether wastes and basalt deltas, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.slagspitter.role: A squat slag toad with a spout on its snout that bombards you from range. It lobs molten globs at anything 6 to 20 blocks away, and where a glob lands the ground burns for four seconds.
guide.teeming.slagspitter.tell: The glowing ring at the root of its spout swells, the spout tips up and it gurgles for nearly a second. Then it spits a glob of slag in a high arc at the spot where you stand.
guide.teeming.snagwood.counter: When it creaks, step behind it or out to one side: the sweep only covers three blocks across its front. An axe bites twice as deep. Leave it alone for eight seconds and it roots back into a snag.
guide.teeming.snagwood.home: Forests, but never the dark forest. It stands among the living trees as one more dead snag.
guide.teeming.snagwood.role: A dead tree that walks. Rooted, it looks like any broken snag until you come within five blocks. Then it tears its roots free and lumbers after you, slowly.
guide.teeming.snagwood.tell: It creaks, leans back and raises its dead limbs for just over half a second, bark dust falling, then sweeps its roots across the ground in front of it.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.counter: It turns slowly, so circle it. Step aside when the jaws open and the seed flies past. From behind, where the seed sac glows gold, your hits do double damage.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.home: Lush caves and the jungle floor.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.role: A rooted flower with a jaw for a head. It never leaves its spot, spits hard seeds at anything within fourteen blocks and bites whatever stands next to it.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.tell: Its jaws open for half a second with a glowing seed inside, then it spits or snaps.
guide.teeming.snowroller.counter: Step out of its line, or get a wall between you. A Snowroller that hits a wall lies stunned on its back for three seconds and takes half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.snowroller.home: Snowy slopes, groves and jagged peaks, after dark.
guide.teeming.snowroller.role: A snow beast that curls into a ball and rolls downhill at you, growing bigger and hitting harder the farther it rolls.
guide.teeming.snowroller.tell: It tucks its head and legs in and curls up for most of a second, puffing snow.
guide.teeming.soot_manta.counter: Get clear before the cloud bursts, and fight it from outside the soot: anyone inside is blinded and plunged into darkness. Hurt it past half its health and it flees.
guide.teeming.soot_manta.home: The air over the Nether's lava seas.
guide.teeming.soot_manta.role: A wide, flat ray that glides over the lava and swoops in to bite. The bite is weak; the soot it sheds is not.
guide.teeming.soot_manta.tell: Close to you, it stops in the air and its wings ripple for a second while soot streams off their edges.
guide.teeming.soulfire_seer.counter: Get behind a block while the line is drawn, or step aside once it stops following you. A beam that hits nothing burns out its eye: it is blind for four seconds, loses you and can't shoot or back away. Close in then.
guide.teeming.soulfire_seer.role: A tall, cowled prophet with a staff of vertebrae that keeps its distance and snipes. Every five seconds it fires a soul-fire beam at anything it can see within thirty-two blocks: the beam strikes the first thing in its way for heavy damage and sets it alight with soul fire.
guide.teeming.soulfire_seer.tell: A thin soul-blue line runs from its burning eye to you for over a second, with a rising whine. The line follows you at first, then holds still for the last moment before the beam.
guide.teeming.soulward_revenant.counter: Watch its glow. Once its seams burn white, every blow fills it twice as fast: stop hitting and step back out of reach, or set it off from more than five blocks away. A nova that catches no one cracks its breastplate: for three seconds it has no armour and nothing fills it.
guide.teeming.soulward_revenant.role: A tall armoured revenant bound in soul chains. Every blow it takes fills it with souls, and the seams of its armour glow brighter as it fills.
guide.teeming.soulward_revenant.tell: Full of souls, it kneels for a second while a toll rises and souls stream into it, then releases a nova: heavy damage and a hard shove to everything within five blocks.
guide.teeming.spore_cannon.counter: Hit the glowing bulb on top before it fires, or while it fires: an arrow or a blow up there lands double, knocks the spores out of the air and stuns it for four seconds, when every hit lands double. A spore pops with one hit, so swat the ones that come at you or shoot them down.
guide.teeming.spore_cannon.home: Warped and crimson forests, rooted alone among the fungus.
guide.teeming.spore_cannon.role: A squat fungus turret that never moves. Every four seconds it fires three spores that climb out of its bulb and then home in on you, four damage each.
guide.teeming.spore_cannon.tell: Its bulb swells and glows gold for a second and it hisses louder and louder. Then the spores fly, one after another.
guide.teeming.stormeel.counter: Get out of the water while it glows: onto the shore, onto a block above the surface or into a boat, or swim more than five blocks away. On land it can only flop back towards the sea, and it dries out.
guide.teeming.stormeel.home: Warm and lukewarm oceans, in the water.
guide.teeming.stormeel.role: A slim eel that hunts swimmers. It stores a charge in the spots along its flanks and lets it go through the water around it.
guide.teeming.stormeel.tell: Its spots glow brighter and crackle with sparks for a second and a half, then it discharges: everything in the water within five blocks takes a heavy shock.
guide.teeming.thornhorn.counter: Step aside when it charges. If it runs into a wall it is stunned for three seconds and takes half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.thornhorn.role: A grazer that leaves you alone until one of the herd is hurt. Then they all turn on you.
guide.teeming.thornhorn.tell: It lowers its horns and paws the ground for a second.
guide.teeming.veinleech.counter: Break its line of sight: put a block, a tree or a corner between you, or get more than ten blocks away. The vein snaps and the leech lies stunned for two seconds; hit it then.
guide.teeming.veinleech.home: Crimson forests, alone or in pairs.
guide.teeming.veinleech.role: A fat leech that shoots a living vein into whatever it can see within ten blocks. While the vein holds, it drinks your health and heals itself.
guide.teeming.veinleech.tell: It rears up, its round mouth flares and the ring of hooked teeth opens wide with a wet sucking sound, for half a second before the vein shoots out.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.counter: Step out of the shadow before it lands. If it wraps you, you are slowed to a crawl and squeezed once a second for four seconds: cut it off with shears, or with a fully charged sword swing while you stand on the ground. It is knocked loose and lies stunned for three seconds, taking half again as much damage. Hit it while it hangs and it lets go and falls.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.home: Jungles, hanging upside down under the leaves of the canopy, up to twelve blocks above the ground.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.role: A knot of vines that waits in the trees for something to walk underneath. It creeps along the underside of the leaves to get above its prey, drops on it and wraps it up.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.tell: For just over half a second a dark ring of shadow shows on the ground where it will land, leaves fall and the canopy rustles. Then it drops.
guide.teeming.warpseed_bloom.counter: Step out of the seed's path, or raise a shield toward the bloom. A blocked seed bursts back on the bloom and tears its bulb: for five seconds it hangs split and dark and spits nothing, so walk in and cut it down.
guide.teeming.warpseed_bloom.role: A chorus flower grown into a turret: a knotted stalk rooted where it grew, with a violet bulb on top. It never moves, and spits slow lilac warpseeds at anything within sixteen blocks. A seed that hits deals a little damage and throws you three to six blocks in a random direction, always onto safe ground.
guide.teeming.warpseed_bloom.tell: Its bulb swells, its veins glow lilac and it creaks higher and higher, then it spits the seed.
guide.teeming.weepling_broodmother.count: Pop the pale, glowing sacs before they hatch: one hit bursts each. Burst a whole clutch and she grieves and lays nothing for another ten seconds. Or kill her first: her unhatched sacs burst with her and her weeplings wither five seconds later.
guide.teeming.weepling_broodmother.role: A bloated crimson mother dragging a swollen abdomen full of brood. Every ten seconds in a fight she lays two pale sacs beside her, and three seconds later each one hatches a weepling: a small crying creature that rushes you. She keeps at most six sacs and weeplings at once.
guide.teeming.weepling_broodmother.tell: She squats, her abdomen swells and pulses and she lets out a wet groan for a second before the sacs drop.
guide.teeming.woolcap_grazer.counter: Shear it calmly for one or two fungal fleece; it grows a new cap by grazing on nylium. Don't hit one in a crowd: the herd tramples back and forth for five seconds, and none of them can be sheared until it settles.
guide.teeming.woolcap_grazer.home: Warped and crimson forests, in herds of two to four, grazing on the nylium.
guide.teeming.woolcap_grazer.role: A shaggy grazer whose fleece is a cap of warped fungus. It never attacks, but hurt one and the whole herd stampedes, knocking aside anyone in its way. Feed two of them warped roots and they bring a calf.
guide.teeming.woolcap_grazer.tell: It has no warning to watch for: it never fights. A hurt one bellows and the herd bolts at once.
